title: Category details "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab shows a blank page

full_report.title: Category details "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab shows a blank page
full_report.observed_behavior: On the CategoryDetailsActivity screen for a category, if the user taps the "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab, the app shows a blank page (no content displayed).
full_report.expected_behavior: The app should display the parent categories of the current category after tapping the "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the app.
2. Swipe left on the welcome/onboarding screen.
3. Swipe left again.
4. Swipe left again.
5. Swipe left again.
6. Tap "YES!" on the final onboarding screen.
7. Open the navigation drawer (hamburger button).
8. Tap "Bookmarks".
9. Tap the navigation drawer "Open" button.
10. In the navigation drawer, tap "Explore".
11. From Explore (category images grid), tap a category image.
12. Swipe up.
13. Tap a category image again.
14. Swipe up.
15. Swipe up.
16. Tap a category image.
17. Swipe up.
18. Tap a category name under "Categories" (e.g., "Focus stacking images of insects") to open the category details screen.
19. Tap the "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab.

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:

Triggering GUI Interaction: clicks the Parent Categories tab
Triggering Screen Reference: Category screen, Parent Categories tab
Correct Behavior: The Parent Categories of the current category should be displayed
